title: Detecting and Classifying Multiple Network Intrusions Using the Real-Time Dataset
abstract: Research on machine-learning approaches for network intrusion detection using the UNSW-NB15 dataset. The study covers data preprocessing, feature engineering, and dataset balancing, followed by the implementation and evaluation of Artificial Neural Networks and Random Forest models. Controlled experiments compare model performance using accuracy, precision, recall, and ROC analysis. The resulting manuscript is co-authored and currently under peer review for international publication.
notes: Co-authored with Dr. Amol Vibhute, Assistant Professor, Symbiosis Institute of Computer Studies and Research.
